title: Thimble Creek Devs
text:
Thimble Creek Devs

notes:
Lead source: inbound (community tutorial). Founder quote: "we need predictable unit costs — want to avoid surprises after POC."
Primary use: code-assistant + knowledge base search (embeddings).
Latency goals: <150ms p99 for chat playground; throughput target for POC ~50-100 qps for batch embeddings.
Cost sensitivity: high — small cash runway, will optimize for hosted API pricing and batching suggestions.
Procurement: prefers CC; procurement team asks for invoice option if ARR > $5k/mo. Asked about startup discount (YC listed).
Security: wants SSO/SAML + audit logs; SOC2 compliance required for marketplace listing later.
POC success metrics: accuracy (top-5 rerank improvement), latency p99 under target, cost per embedding under $0.0015.
Quoted concerns: "If we hit higher usage, need predictable pricing and option to pin model versions."
Action notes: send pricing matrix (CC vs invoice), include startup discount instructions, propose free credits extension (extra $500) conditional on POC kickoff date.
Stubs: fireflies FF-20260302-90321, drive pricing file, INF-4521.

recent_activities:
2026-02-10 - Self-serve signup: claimed $250 free credits, API key created, immediate test calls for embeddings.
2026-02-18 - Email: asked about CC vs invoice; prefers credit card but may require PO for later stages.
2026-02-28 - Demo call (30m) w/ AE Aria + SE Marco: walkthrough hosted API, model catalog; asked about latency @100 qps.
2026-03-02 - Security questionnaire submitted (SAML & SOC2 sections); SE to confirm audit logging retention options.
2026-03-04 - Follow-up: requested startup discount and potential free credits extension for 6-week POC.

next_step:
Send tailored pricing + CC vs invoice options; confirm free credits extension; schedule 30m POC kickoff week of 2026-03-15.
